scope: One shared admission budget for Turbopack worker-pool facades
sourcePolicy: Fork patches committed on yolo; native importer generated vendor history; dev merges generated changes. No engine sources moved into Aphrody.
changes: Concurrency and bootup semaphores belong to PoolState keyed by cwd and entrypoint.
Repeated compatible facades reuse one budget; incompatible concurrency returns an explicit error instead of a second budget.
Cancelled and dropped reservations return to the shared owner.

budgetModule.serialization: shared Aphrody Cargo flock; sccache for rustc; same-version clippy-driver -D warnings pass
budgetModule.notACopy: The compiler reads the production module directly; no engine rebuild or replacement implementation.

validation.format: four source files in fork and imported copy pass rustfmt check
validation.import: native yolo import generates byte-identical pool sources; pins in vendor.lock

registryTests.reason: Require the full worker_pool crate/factory gate.

limits: No complete Turbopack addon, Bun compatibility, React/Next application build or memory/throughput gain is qualified.
The full crate checks and two registry tests remain pending behind the active shared factory lock.
This removes the demonstrated per-facade budget duplication; it does not unify all JS engines or all dependencies.
